name: RTX SYLPH
description: Voice + text companion with Flight/studio license, aptitude sliders, Grok Bot launch, Netflix/Prime, TMDB watch desk, Ara voice, world clock, and AI council.
author: DailyDriver007

functions.name: ask_ai
functions.description: Activate the AI council. Queries Grok, Gemini Flash 3.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Nemotron 3 Super, Nemotron Ultra 253B, and Mistral in parallel, then Grok-led refinement.

functions.name: chat
functions.description: Talk to SYLPH in the text console. Optional file_path for an image, video, or document.

file_path.description: Optional local file, image, or video path

functions.name: open_netflix
functions.description: Open Netflix in the user's browser or installed app. Does not log into Netflix for them.

functions.name: open_prime
functions.description: Open Amazon Prime Video in the user's browser or installed app.

functions.name: watch_suggest
functions.description: Suggest what to watch on Netflix and/or Prime using TMDB public watch-provider data and Grok. Does not scrape Netflix or Amazon.

functions.name: quiet_hours
functions.description: Mute wake listening except 'sylph I'm back'.

functions.name: focus_timer
functions.description: Start a pomodoro/focus countdown SYLPH will announce.

functions.name: screenshot_ask
functions.description: Capture the desktop and ask SYLPH what is on screen.

functions.name: unlock_license
functions.description: Activate a Full Grok / Flight license key (SYLPH-PREM-… or SYLPH-SUB-…). Ships as studio until unlocked.

functions.name: sylph_mode
functions.description: Switch between Flight (full xAI Grok) and studio demo. Requires a license. Default on a licensed machine is Flight.

functions.name: set_aptitude
functions.description: Set an aptitude 0-100: accuracy, wit, depth, or spoken. Licensed machines only.

functions.name: open_grok_bot
functions.description: Open official Grok Bot (xAI teammate with its own cloud computer). Included with SuperGrok Plus. No public Bot API yet.

functions.name: world_clock
functions.description: Speak and report the always-on world clock: Pacific, Eastern, London, Berlin, UTC, India, Beijing, Tokyo, Sydney, Sao Paulo.

functions.name: gpu_status
functions.description: Report RTX GPU name, load, and temperature, and switch the avatar to cool or overheat animations.

functions.name: sys_status
functions.description: Report CPU, RAM, disk, and GPU load together.

functions.name: volume_control
functions.description: Mute, unmute, or set Windows master volume.

action.description: mute, unmute, up, down, or set

functions.name: take_screenshot
functions.description: Capture the desktop and save it under Pictures/Screenshots.

functions.name: lock_pc
functions.description: Lock the Windows workstation.

functions.name: lights_control
functions.description: Control smart lights via Home Assistant (on, off, color, or status) for a room.

room.description: Room or Home Assistant light entity suffix

color.description: Color name such as red, green, blue, purple, cyan, white

functions.name: thermostat_control
functions.description: Read or set the Home Assistant thermostat temperature.

temperature.description: Target temperature in Fahrenheit when action is set

functions.name: home_control
functions.description: Control a Home Assistant device: lights, thermostat, lock, garage, blinds, fan, tv, music, alarm, or sensor.

device.description: Device name: lights, thermostat, lock, garage, blinds, fan, tv, music, alarm, sensor

action.description: status, on, off, open, close, arm, disarm, or set

value.description: Numeric value for set (temperature or volume)

functions.name: alexa_command
functions.description: Send a spoken-style command intended for Alexa (requires Home Assistant integration for real control).

functions.name: google_command
functions.description: Send a spoken-style command intended for Google Home (requires Home Assistant integration for real control).

command.description: Command to send to Google Home

functions.name: camera_spiral
functions.description: Open configured cameras in an adaptive spiral of windows around SYLPH.

cameras.description: all, or a comma-separated list of camera names

functions.name: camera_view
functions.description: Open a single Ring or IP camera live view.

camera.description: Camera name such as front_door, backyard, doorbell, garage

functions.name: find_airtag
functions.description: Open Apple Find My in the browser to locate an AirTag.

item.description: Item name, for example keys or wallet

functions.name: screencast
functions.description: Start or stop Windows Miracast / projection to a smart TV.

functions.name: close_all
functions.description: Close all Chrome/Edge council and camera windows spawned by SYLPH.

functions.name: randomize_avatar
functions.description: Play a random clip from the current animation class.

functions.name: sequential_avatar
functions.description: Play animation clips in order for the current class.

functions.name: use_avatar
functions.description: Force a specific avatar video for a number of minutes.

video_name.description: Video file name without path, for example SYLPH_IDLE_5

duration_minutes.description: How long to keep this clip, in minutes
